content:
Product and Integration Updates

This week, integration efforts and new product launches gained momentum in the AI ecosystem. Apple, which is preparing to unveil the new Gemini-powered Siri in February, stated that it will use a dedicated cloud infrastructure to ensure the security of user data. Meanwhile, OpenAI announced Prism, a LaTeX-based tool for scientific research, and it was discovered that ChatGPT has begun using Grokipedia data owned by xAI.

Other notable developments include:

  • Anthropic: Claude has begun integrating with business applications such as Slack, Figma, and Asana. However, the company is facing a $3 billion copyright lawsuit filed by music publishers.
  • Google: Gemini features have been added to the Chrome browser, and Project Genie—which enables the creation of interactive worlds—has been launched.

Agentic AI and Hardware

Autonomous agents and the hardware that supports these models remain a key focus. Microsoft introduced the Maia 200 chip to scale AI inference. Apple, meanwhile, invested in sensor-based nonverbal communication technologies by acquiring the voice technology startup Q.ai for $2 billion.

  • Wonderful: The Agent Builder platform, which enables companies to create autonomous agents, was announced.
  • Clawdbot: An open-source personal AI assistant has been made available to developers.
  • Snap: It is spinning off its AR glasses division into an independent company open to outside investment.

New Models and Open Source

This week’s model-related innovations focused primarily on computer vision and coding:

  • DeepSeek: Released its OCR 2 model, focused on text extraction from documents, as open source.
  • Luma AI: The video generation model Ray3.14 was released with faster processing capabilities.
  • Gemini 3 Flash: The “Agentic Vision” capability, which combines visual reasoning with code execution, was introduced.
  • AI2: SERA, an open-source coding agent powered by Claude Code, was announced.
  • NVIDIA: The PersonaPlex bidirectional conversation model was introduced.

Investment Activity

Cash flow in the sector continues with large-scale acquisitions and investments:

  • NVIDIA: Invested $2 billion in CoreWeave.
  • Tesla: Provided $2 billion in funding for Elon Musk’s xAI venture.
  • Synthesia: Raised $200 million at a $4 billion valuation.
  • Ricursive Intelligence: Completed a $300 million Series A funding round.
  • Microsoft: Announced that its partnership with OpenAI contributed $7.6 billion to its quarterly profit.
